buffer_size.description: Input buffer size in bytes. Default is 8192. Corresponds to the -bsize flag.

verbosity.description: Verbosity level. Must be one of 'quiet', 'normal', or 'verbose'. Corresponds to -q, -Q, or -v flags.

streams.description: List of stream mappings specifying which input file descriptors send to which output file descriptors. Supports EOF signaling for outputs via eof_signal flag. Corresponds to fdin-fdout,fdout... arguments and the e-suffix for EOF propagation.
